patch_description:
This rewrite fixes a unit-square convex hull using four permanent corner vertices and optimizes the remaining nine points. This removes repeated convex-hull computations, guarantees a valid unit-area convex containing region, and spends the saved evaluation budget on more active-set maximin search.

The search combines lower-tail annealing, area-gradient proposals, targeted correlated two-vertex moves, deterministic low-discrepancy initializations, and a final coordinate/pattern-search polish focused on the strict reported minimum triangle area.
